# CompressTo20KB
> Free online image compressor that runs entirely in the browser: nothing is uploaded, no account, no watermark. Set a kilobyte ceiling (20KB, 50KB, 240KB, any number between 5KB and 5000KB) and the tool searches encoding quality until the file lands at or under it, then reports the exact output byte count. Handles JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC, up to 50 files per batch. Every specification quoted on the site carries its official source and a checked date; where a platform publishes no limit, the page says so instead of inventing one.

## Verified image size limits (with primary sources)

Only figures an official publisher states. Checked October 2026. Anything not listed here, we do not claim.

- **US digital visa photo (DS-160 and DV Lottery):** JPEG, 240KB or smaller, between 600x600 and 1200x1200 pixels — US Department of State, travel.state.gov
- **UK visa or document photo (online):** at least 600px wide and 750px tall, between 50KB and 6MB, JPEG, vertical — gov.uk
- **India e-Visa:** JPEG, square, minimum 10KB and maximum 300KB — indianvisaonline.gov.in
- **NEET-UG photograph (India):** JPEG, 10KB to 200KB; postcard-size photograph 50KB to 300KB — nta.ac.in public notice
- **UPSC online application photograph/signature:** 20KB to 300KB — upsconline.gov.in candidate FAQ
- **SAT (College Board):** accepted formats are .jpg, .gif and .png; no file-size ceiling and no pixel box is published — satsuite.collegeboard.org
- **GRE (ETS):** an original, physical, recent recognizable photograph is required for ID; ETS publishes no file-size specification — ets.org
- **GMAT (GMAC):** identification is a physical original document; there is no applicant photo upload in registration — mba.com / support.mba.com
- **Common App:** the application has no applicant photo field; the only published image ceiling we found is SlideRoom portfolios under 5MB — commonapp.org / liaison.edu

A minimum matters as much as a maximum: several of these forms reject a file that is too small, and no compressor can make a file larger.

## What this tool will not do

It does not crop to a ratio, resize to a specific pixel box, replace or flatten a background, sharpen a soft image, preserve animation, or hit an exact byte count. It reduces quality until the file fits under your ceiling and reports the resulting byte count. Longest side is capped at 4096px.
